escenas.texto: Festival decorations, kitchen stories, a game launch and one unstoppable show. This week, Asia did not stop clicking. The thirty videos in this countdown add up to over five hundred and sixty million views. Thirty videos, three lists, and only three crowns. Welcome to Top 10 Social Media, Asia edition. Today we count down the ten most viewed, the ten most commented and the ten most liked videos of the week. And I'll warn you now: one name is about to dominate this episode. Which one? Stay until the end.

The rules, quick and clear. Only videos posted in the last seven days that trended in Asia. One video per creator on each list. Music and news have their own space. Every number comes straight from the official YouTube API, measured this Wednesday. Ready? Let's go.

We open with the ten most viewed. Number ten, from India, Kitchen CureAI, with a family kitchen story of about three minutes, posted four days ago. Over eighteen million seven hundred thousand views, and over four hundred and ninety thousand likes. Remember that channel, by the way. It isn't done with us today.

Number nine, and it's tight. From Indonesia, Aletha Abew, a channel with seventeen million subscribers. A Short of just forty-one seconds, posted three days ago. Over eighteen point seven million views. Just a few thousand views separate it from number ten.

At number eight, from Pakistan, Heemi, with “She made a huge comeback this year!”. Over nineteen point three million views, from a channel with about one hundred and twenty-four thousand subscribers. A sixteen-second Short, punching way above its weight.

Number seven, from India, Snow_berrygifts, with a colour challenge Short of forty-six seconds. Over nineteen point seven million views, and over one thousand seven hundred comments. The channel? About ninety-four thousand subscribers.

Up we go. Number six, from India, JAI HIND OFFICIAL. A twenty-five second Short, posted five days ago, with over twenty-two point nine million views. All that from a channel with about one hundred and fifty-two thousand subscribers.

Halfway there. Number five, from South Korea, DoubleBite, with “Water vs Dried Fish”. Fifty-nine seconds, over twenty-five million views and over three hundred and forty-five thousand likes. Keep an eye on this one too: we may see it again.

And now the big numbers start. Number four, WIUFQFYEQ, a channel with about thirty-four thousand subscribers. A thirty-one second Short, posted three days ago, with over twenty-eight point eight million views. Let that sink in. Now, the podium.

Bronze medal, ARTIST JOYBOY, with “Drawing LISA using 69 from Tarantino”. A drawing Short of twenty-one seconds that pulled in over thirty-three point two million views. The channel has about sixty-seven thousand subscribers. Bronze in Asia. Impressive. But two videos went even higher.

Silver medal, from India, Samay Raina, with India's Got Latent, season two, episode eight. Not a Short: a full episode of over fifty minutes, posted just two days ago, with over forty-four point three million views. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about six hundred and eighty thousand views per hour. A monster. And still, it's not number one.

Drum roll, please. Number one most viewed in Asia, from India, Shivapriya Official, with “Mango leaf decoration ideas for diwali”. Over forty-seven point six million views. A Short of just twenty seconds, from a channel with about one hundred and thirty-four thousand subscribers. Twenty seconds of festival decoration beat a fifty-minute megahit. That's the power of Diwali week.

Now let's turn up the conversation: the ten most commented videos. Number ten, from the United Arab Emirates, Esraa Gaming, with Poppy Playtime Chapter two. A gameplay over seventy-two minutes long, and still, over six thousand seven hundred comments and over eight hundred and thirty thousand views.
Number nine, from India, Shivang Mini, with “I UPGRADED MY SUBSCRIBERS ACCOUNT IN STEAL AN EGG ROBLOX”. Over eight thousand comments and over one point three million views.

Number eight, from Indonesia, Nadia Omara, a channel with over seventeen million subscribers. A video over thirty minutes long, posted five days ago. Over eight thousand five hundred comments and over eight point nine million views.
Number seven, from Japan, Ado, with “Patient A”. Under five minutes long, with over eight thousand nine hundred comments in three days, plus over one point seven million views.

Number six, from Iraq, Atro, with a PUBG Mobile video over twenty-five minutes long. Over ten thousand comments. And it has the best engagement rate on this list: seven out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. A loyal, loud community.

Number five, from India, Techno Gamerz, a channel with over fifty-three million subscribers. “Welcome to Vietnam”, part six of their First Light gameplay. Over one hundred and one minutes long, with over eleven thousand comments and over five million views.

Number four, the duo لانا و رورو, with a Roblox gameplay over eighteen minutes long, posted three days ago. Over thirteen thousand four hundred comments, from just over seven hundred and seventy thousand views. And now, the podium of the conversation.
Bronze medal, from India, Free Fire India Official, with “FREE FIRE INDIA IS HERE!”. It got there in just one day. Over twenty-seven thousand comments and over five point three million views.

Silver medal, from India, What Factzz, with “Tennis Ball”. A twenty-seven second Short with over forty-five thousand four hundred comments, from a channel with about one hundred and twenty-seven thousand subscribers. And hold on, because the gap to number one is almost nothing.

And the number one most commented... from India, Samay Raina, again! India's Got Latent, season two, episode eight. Over forty-five thousand five hundred comments. The difference with second place? Just fifty-nine comments. Fifty-nine! Silver in views, gold in comments. But is that all for this episode? We'll see.

And the last list, the one that measures love: the ten most liked videos. Number ten, a familiar face. From India, Shivapriya Official, with “Mango leaf decoration ideas for diwali”, our number one in views. Here, over three hundred and fourteen thousand likes.
Number nine, from India, Rhino Rule, with “I Tried Most Expensive RC Helicopter”. Over three hundred and seventeen thousand likes and over nine point seven million views.

Number eight, from India, Gyan studio Bari, a channel with about thirty-three thousand subscribers. A video posted six days ago with over ten point two million views and over three hundred and nineteen thousand likes.
Number seven, from the United Arab Emirates, Priya and Sid, with “UNLIMITED chocolate at the Lindt Factory!”. Over three hundred and twenty-eight thousand likes and over ten point two million views.
Number six, back again from South Korea, DoubleBite, with “Water vs Dried Fish”. Fifth in views, and here over three hundred and forty-five thousand likes.

Number five, What Factzz, our silver in comments, with “Tennis Ball”. Over four hundred and seventy-five thousand likes. It has the best engagement rate on this list: five out of every hundred viewers liked or commented.

Number four, Indu kanchan Singh, a channel with about one hundred and twenty-seven thousand subscribers. A family story of three minutes, posted six days ago. Over four hundred and seventy-nine thousand likes and over nine point nine million views. Now, the final podium of the week.

Bronze medal, from Pakistan, Heemi, with “She made a huge comeback this year!”. Eighth in views, and here over five hundred and twenty-nine thousand likes. A sixteen-second Short climbing to the podium.

Silver medal, from India, Kitchen CureAI. Remember them from number ten in views? This is a different video: another family kitchen story, posted six days ago, with over six hundred and eighty-four thousand likes and over sixteen point five million views.

And the number one most liked in Asia... Samay Raina, one more time! India's Got Latent, season two, episode eight. Over one point two million likes. Silver in views, gold in comments and gold in likes. Over fifty minutes long, and about six hundred and eighty thousand views per hour. This week in Asia, one show ruled them all.

And some news: starting week forty-five we add TikTok. The ten most viral TikTok videos of the week, right here too. Don't miss it. And the world tour isn't over. Next stop: Africa. The link is in the description and in the playlist. Now it's your turn: which video should have made this countdown? Tell us in the comments with the hashtag Top10RS. Links to every original video are in the description: go support the creators. Subscribe and hit the bell, so you're the first to know the winners in Asia every Sunday. And watch out: the top three of each list move on to the global ranking. Next week, that video could be yours. And a question for you: do you want us to hold a real award for the Top 10 winners? If you do, write the hashtag Premios Top 10 RS in the comments, all in one word.
